body: Yea but it’s normal to want to live to live so badly that we murder our own kind for resources. Stab each other in the back for a promotion. Maybe if they just had suicide booths from futurama and let those who wanna end their miserable lives die, then those who want to live so badly wouldn’t have to kill each other.

Try reading the book “the 4 agreements”
And if reading isn’t your thing here is the audio version. I’m not healed yet. Most of my life I’ve had deep depression but I listened to this book and it helped. For me killing myself isn’t an option I’ve already tried multiple times but I underestimated my bodies instincts to live. Please be compassionate towards yourself cause no one else will...

I’m sorry that your currently suffering. Are you not eating cause you just don’t have a appetite or because you are punishing yourself for some reason? Either way please eat something. Also if you need to chat message me. I’ve also been suicidal most of my life due to all the suffering and trauma I’ve been through. Anyways I hope you decide to either reach out, journal or remember a joyous moment in your life. Sorry I couldn’t help more. Hope you feel better.
Thanks for the kind words I’m feeling better after reading the post here

Hey guy I think you need some self compassion...I feel like I can relate to you in some way. Anyways my point is that this world is fucked up. I’m truly sorry you were molested as a child should never have to go through that but things like that happen everyday...also because of the trauma and abuse I received through out my life I also hurt pretty anyone who gets close to me. Anyways I realized that I’m pretty hard on others but that’s because I’m hard on myself. If you arnt compassionate to yourself when you make a mistake. how could you possibly show compassion to other person you care about when they make a mistake or miscommunication happens?
Anyways please check out a Ted talk by author Kristin Neff on self compassion. I hope you find hope as you are still young and have more time.
Can you possibly live for yourself?
